note: Lore auto-wrap — the cross-language contract behind manifest `lore_max_width`. The plugin (render/LoreWrap.kt) wraps each rendered lore line before parsing it; the editor (lib/loreWrap.ts) wraps the preview with the same algorithm, so the tooltip shows what the player sees. Width is in MC pixels from the vanilla font advances (a=6, b=6, space=4, i=2, bold +1 per char). Words never split; a continuation line reopens the tags still open where it starts. Owned by: plugin LoreWrapConformanceTest + editor lib/loreWrap.test.ts.
